description: This Java interface defines the DittoHeaders, which represent headers for commands and responses in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for accessing various header properties such as correlation ID, content type, authorization context, response requirements, and more. It also provides static factory methods for creating and manipulating header instances.

classes.name: DittoHeaders
classes.description: Interface for headers used in commands and responses within the Eclipse Ditto framework, providing access to various header properties and factory methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DittoHeaders instance from a given map of headers.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for constructing DittoHeaders.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder initialized with the current headers.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves the correlation ID for message grouping.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the content type of the entity.

methods.name: isResponseRequired
methods.description: Indicates if a response is required.

methods.name: isDryRun
methods.description: Indicates if the command is a dry run.

methods.name: getIfMatch
methods.description: Retrieves entity tags in the If-Match header.

methods.name: getIfNoneMatch
methods.description: Retrieves entity tags in the If-None-Match header.

methods.name: getInboundPayloadMapper
methods.description: Retrieves the inbound payload mapper ID.

methods.name: getExpectedResponseTypes
methods.description: Retrieves the response types to be published.

methods.name: isEntriesSizeGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks if headers size exceeds a given limit.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates headers to a specified size limit.

methods.name: isAllowPolicyLockout
methods.description: Checks if policy lockout is allowed.
